title_en: Alaska Airlines Launches Invite-Only Global Concierge Status To Rival US Big Three
title_zh: 阿拉斯加航空向竞争对手美国三巨头推出仅限受邀者的全球礼宾资格
summary: Alaska Airlines launches Atmos Global Concierge, an invite-only elite status offering premium travelers personalized support and exclusive benefits.
summary_zh: 阿拉斯加航空推出 Atmos 全球礼宾服务，这是一种仅限受邀人士的精英身份，为优质旅客提供个性化支持和专属福利。
body_en: Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

Alaska Airlines has introduced Atmos Global Concierge, an invitation-only elite status program that recognizes its most valuable customers with personalized travel assistance and exclusive benefits. The new offering sits above the existing Atmos Rewards Titanium tier and brings the Seattle-based carrier closer to American Airlines , Delta Air Lines , and United Airlines , all of which operate their own invitation-only loyalty programs . Invitations began reaching selected Atmos Rewards members on November 9, 2026, with membership currently extending through December 31, 2027. The initiative comes as Alaska continues to expand its international network and strengthen its position in the premium travel market.

The new status is a curious case because Alaska has not published qualification requirements or established a publicly accessible application process. Instead, the airline appears to be selecting travelers based on their overall value to its business, with early reports suggesting that expensive international business class bookings could play an important role. Recipients are also being offered complimentary Titanium status, alongside a collection of services intended to make long-haul journeys more convenient. Although the program remains in its early stages, it represents another important development in Alaska's evolving loyalty strategy.

Atmos Global Concierge provides invited members with access to a dedicated support team responsible for assisting them throughout their journeys. According to information shared by recipients on Reddit , the benefits include proactive flight monitoring, assistance during travel disruptions, and a next-flight guarantee intended to help passengers reach their destinations when their original itineraries are disrupted. Members can also receive arrival assistance at selected long-haul destinations across Europe, Asia, and Oceania. Another benefit is car transfers at London Heathrow Airport (LHR) for passengers with tight connections.

The reported package also includes upgrade priority above regular Titanium members, particularly on international flights, alongside complimentary CLEAR+ membership and Avis Chairman's Club status. These benefits combine airport assistance, ground transportation, and additional travel privileges rather than focusing exclusively on earning more points or accessing airport lounges. According to One Mile at a Time , recipients can retain their new status through December 31, 2027. Alaska has also confirmed the broader purpose of the initiative, stating the following to Simple Flying

“Atmos™ Global Concierge is a new, invitation-only program that, in addition to all the award-winning benefits of Atmos Rewards membership, provides personalized travel support when you need it the most. Members are supported by a dedicated Concierge team throughout their journey, including proactive trip monitoring and travel assistance, along with exclusive benefits and curated experiences. Through this beta program, we’re creating new ways to recognize some of our most loyal members as our global network grows.”
An Invitation-Only Alternative To The Big Three

The introduction of Global Concierge places Alaska alongside the three largest US network carriers in offering exclusive recognition to selected customers. American Airlines operates ConciergeKey, Delta Air Lines has Delta 360, while United Airlines offers Global Services. These programs are generally reserved for travelers considered especially valuable to their respective airlines, with spending patterns, premium cabin bookings, and corporate travel relationships often believed to influence selection. Qualification criteria are typically confidential, making invitations hard to predict even for frequent flyers.

Early reactions from Atmos Rewards members suggest that Alaska may be prioritizing the value of individual bookings rather than simply rewarding the highest number of status points. Reports shared on Reddit indicate that some recipients regularly purchase international business class tickets, while other members with substantial status-point balances have not received invitations. This suggests the airline may be trying to attract customers who might otherwise spend heavily with competing international carriers.

The distinction between Global Concierge and conventional elite status is that it appears to emphasize personalized assistance rather than simply offering additional mileage bonuses or airport privileges. For passengers traveling internationally, having an airline team monitor their itineraries and arrange alternatives during disruptions could be very valuable. A missed connection at a major European hub, for example, can create significant complications when passengers have connecting flights operated by different carriers. Alaska's reported Heathrow transfer benefit also indicates that the airline is looking beyond its own aircraft operations to improve the overall travel experience.

The initiative also reflects a broader effort to retain premium customers as Alaska expands its international operations. Following its acquisition of Hawaiian Airlines , the company has gained access to a substantially broader network and greater opportunities to compete for long-haul passengers. Recognizing travelers who regularly purchase expensive international tickets could help strengthen loyalty as Alaska develops additional services and competes with established global airlines.

Alaska has described Global Concierge as a beta program designed to develop new ways to recognize its most loyal customers as its global network grows. In a comment explaining the initiative, the airline said the new offering supplements existing Atmos Rewards benefits with personalized support, proactive travel monitoring, exclusive privileges, and curated experiences. The company also highlighted the importance of having a dedicated team available throughout each member's journey, particularly when unexpected travel complications arise. This suggests that Alaska sees the program as more than another loyalty designation, positioning it instead as a premium service offering that could evolve as the airline gathers feedback.
body_zh: 经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。

阿拉斯加航空推出了 Atmos Global Concierge，这是一项仅限受邀人士参加的精英身份计划，旨在通过个性化旅行帮助和专属福利来表彰其最有价值的客户。新的服务高于现有的 Atmos Rewards Titanium 等级，使这家总部位于西雅图的航空公司更接近美国航空、达美航空和联合航空，这些航空公司都运营自己的仅限受邀会员的忠诚度计划。邀请函于 2026 年 11 月 9 日开始向选定的 Atmos Rewards 会员发出，会员资格目前有效期延长至 2027 年 12 月 31 日。该计划的推出正值阿拉斯加继续扩大其国际网络并巩固其在高端旅行市场的地位。
新的身份是一个奇怪的案例，因为阿拉斯加尚未公布资格要求或建立公开的申请流程。相反，该航空公司似乎根据旅客对其业务的整体价值来选择旅客，早期报告表明昂贵的国际商务舱预订可能会发挥重要作用。接收者还将获得免费的钛金身份，以及一系列旨在使长途旅行更加方便的服务。尽管该计划仍处于早期阶段，但它代表了阿拉斯加不断发展的忠诚度战略的另一个重要发展。
Atmos 全球礼宾服务为受邀会员提供专门的支持团队，负责在整个旅程中为他们提供帮助。根据 Reddit 上的接收者分享的信息，这些好处包括主动航班监控、旅行中断期间的援助，以及旨在帮助乘客在原始行程中断时到达目的地的下一航班保证。会员还可以在欧洲、亚洲和大洋洲的选定长途目的地获得抵达协助。另一个好处是伦敦希思罗机场 (LHR) 为交通繁忙的乘客提供汽车接送服务。

据报道，该套餐还包括高于普通钛金会员的升级优先权（特别是在国际航班上），以及免​​费的 CLEAR+ 会员资格和安飞士主席俱乐部会员资格。这些福利结合了机场协助、地面交通和额外的旅行特权，而不是仅仅专注于赚取更多积分或使用机场休息室。根据“一次一英里”计划，接收者可以在 2027 年 12 月 31 日之前保留其新身份。阿拉斯加还确认了该计划的更广泛目的，并向 Simple Flying 声明了以下内容
“Atmos™ Global Concierge 是一项仅限受邀人士参与的新计划，除了 Atmos Rewards 会员的所有屡获殊荣的福利之外，还可以在您最需要的时候提供个性化的旅行支持。会员在整个旅程中都会得到专门的礼宾团队的支持，包括主动的旅行监控和旅行协助，以及专属福利和精心策划的体验。通过这个测试版计划，随着我们全球网络的发展，我们正在创建新的方式来认可一些最忠诚的会员。”
三巨头的仅限受邀者的替代方案
全球礼宾服务的推出使阿拉斯加与美国三大网络运营商并驾齐驱，为特定客户提供独家认可。美国航空运营 ConciergeKey，达美航空拥有 Delta 360，而联合航空则提供全球服务。这些计划通常是为那些对其各自的航空公司特别有价值的旅行者保留的，他们的消费模式、高级客舱预订和公司旅行关系通常被认为会影响选择。资格标准通常是保密的，因此即使对于飞行常客来说也很难预测邀请。
Atmos Rewards 会员的早期反应表明，阿拉斯加可能会优先考虑个人预订的价值，而不是简单地奖励最高数量的状态积分。 Reddit 上分享的报告表明，一些接收者定期购买国际商务舱机票，而其他拥有大量等级积分余额的会员则没有收到邀请。这表明该航空公司可能正在努力吸引那些可能会在国际竞争对手那里花费大量资金的客户。
全球礼宾服务与传统精英身份的区别在于，它似乎强调个性化帮助，而不是简单地提供额外的里程奖励或机场特权。对于国际旅行的乘客来说，让航空公司团队监控他们的行程并在中断期间安排替代方案可能非常有价值。例如，当乘客乘坐由不同航空公司运营的转机航班时，在欧洲主要枢纽错过转机可能会造成严重的复杂情况。据报道，阿拉斯加希思罗机场的转机效益也表明该航空公司正在超越自己的飞机运营，以改善整体旅行体验。
该举措还反映出，随着阿拉斯加扩大其国际业务，为留住优质客户而做出了更广泛的努力。收购夏威夷航空后，该公司获得了更广泛的网络和更多竞争长途乘客的机会。随着阿拉斯加开发更多服务并与成熟的全球航空公司竞争，认识到定期购买昂贵国际机票的旅行者可能有助于增强忠诚度。

阿拉斯加将全球礼宾服务描述为一项测试计划，旨在随着其全球网络的发展开发新的方式来识别其最忠诚的客户。该航空公司在解释该举措的评论中表示，新产品通过个性化支持、主动旅行监控、独家特权和精心策划的体验补充了现有的 Atmos Rewards 福利。该公司还强调了在每位会员的旅程中拥有一支专门团队的重要性，特别是在出现意外旅行并发症时。这表明阿拉斯加认为该计划不仅仅是另一个忠诚度称号，而是将其定位为一项优质服务产品，可以随着航空公司收集反馈而不断发展。

summary_zh: 根据拉脱维亚航空公司的初步数据，波罗的海航空 2026 年 10 月的载客量为 447,400 人次，较上年同期的 477,200 人次下降 6%。
body_en: airBaltic passenger traffic falls 6% in October despite record year-to-date total - Aviation24.be
airBaltic carried 447,400 passengers in October 2026, down 6% from 477,200 a year earlier, according to preliminary figures from the Latvian airline.

The carrier operated 4,167 scheduled flights, down 1.2% year on year, while its load factor fell three percentage points to 79.5%. airBaltic attributed the declines mainly to ongoing changes to its network and capacity, as well as wider market conditions.

Despite the October decline, airBaltic carried a record 4,487,800 passengers in the first ten months of 2026, up 2.4% year on year. It operated 41,774 flights over the same period, an increase of 4.7%.

title_en: Netherlands and Germany agree to improve cross-border rail links
title_zh: 荷兰和德国同意改善跨境铁路连接
summary: The Netherlands and Germany have signed a joint declaration to run more cross-border passenger trains, cut journey times, and improve rail freight links. German Transport Minister Steffen Bilger and Dutch State Secretary Annet Bertram signed the agreement in B
summary_zh: 荷兰和德国签署联合声明，将开行更多跨境旅客列车、缩短行程时间并改善铁路货运线路
body_en: Netherlands and Germany agree to improve cross-border rail links - Aviation24.be
Home Railways Deutsche Bahn Netherlands and Germany agree to improve cross-border rail links

The Netherlands and Germany have signed a joint declaration to run more cross-border passenger trains, cut journey times, and improve rail freight links. German Transport Minister Steffen Bilger and Dutch State Secretary Annet Bertram signed the agreement in Berlin on 10 November 2026.

The passenger plans focus on three corridors from Amsterdam: to Hamburg, Berlin and Frankfurt, with onward links towards Copenhagen, Warsaw, Prague, Basel and Vienna. Both governments want to make it easier for new operators to enter the market, but announced no new frequencies or journey-time targets.

For freight, a priority is expanding capacity between Emmerich and Oberhausen, the German link to the Betuweroute connecting the port of Rotterdam with the Ruhr. The two countries also plan to co-ordinate the roll-out of the European Rail Traffic Management System (ERTMS) and make it easier to run 740-metre trains for commercial freight and military transport.
Working groups will develop the proposals, with ministers and infrastructure managers ProRail and DB InfraGO due to review progress annually.

主页 铁路 德国铁路 荷兰和德国同意改善跨境铁路连接
荷兰和德国签署了一份联合声明，将运营更多跨境客运列车、缩短行程时间并改善铁路货运连接。德国交通部长史蒂芬·比尔格 (Steffen Bilger) 和荷兰国务大臣安妮特·伯特伦 (Annet Bertram) 于 2026 年 11 月 10 日在柏林签署了该协议。
客运计划重点关注从阿姆斯特丹出发的三个走廊：前往汉堡、柏林和法兰克福，并继续前往哥本哈根、华沙、布拉格、巴塞尔和维也纳。两国政府都希望让新运营商更容易进入市场，但没有宣布新的频率或旅程时间目标。
对于货运，首要任务是扩大埃默里希和奥伯豪森之间的运力，这是德国通往连接鹿特丹港和鲁尔区的 Betuweroute 的线路。两国还计划协调推出欧洲铁路交通管理系统（ERTMS），让740米长的商业货运和军事运输列车更容易运行。
工作组将与部长和基础设施管理者 ProRail 和 DB InfraGO 一起制定提案，并每年审查进展情况。

body_en: Icelandair to launch weekly Akureyri–Tenerife flights in winter 2027/28 - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Akureyri Airport (AEY) Icelandair to launch weekly Akureyri–Tenerife flights in winter 2027/28
Icelandair will launch a weekly nonstop service from Akureyri to Tenerife on 19 October 2027. Flights will operate on Tuesdays until 18 April 2028.

The route will be Icelandair’s first scheduled international service from Akureyri. The airline has previously operated charter flights from the northern Icelandic airport, chief executive Bogi Nils Bogason said.
The service will give travellers in northern and eastern Iceland a direct link to the Canary Islands without having to travel via Keflavík.

body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

Southwest Airlines will launch a total of five new international routes to its growing network, as the world's largest operator of the Boeing 737 debuts a number of new services during the Northern Hemisphere winter season.

The newest route, which took flight on November 1, connects Las Vegas to Mexico , while more routes are expected to come online at the beginning of 2027. This article will examine Southwest's five new international routes during the winter travel season, which runs from October 25 through March 27, 2027.
Southwest Airlines Connects Las Vegas To Puerto Vallarta

Dallas-based Southwest's newest international route connects Las Vegas Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) to Mexico's Pacific Coast, with up to six weekly flights to Puerto Vallarta (PVR). The route, which began on November 1, becomes the airline's third international service from the Nevada airport after Cancun International Airport (CUN) and San Jose del Cabo (SJD).

For travelers to Puerto Vallarta, Southwest operates year-round to Denver (DEN), Houston (HOU), Las Vegas (LAS), Orange County (SNA), Phoenix (PHX), St. Louis (STL), and San Diego (SAN). Seasonal destinations include Austin (AUS) and Sacramento (SMF).
Southwest is Puerto Vallarta's second-largest international carrier by total destinations served, with nine. This follows Canadian carrier WestJet with 12, and ahead of both United and Delta at six.
Nashville Gains Two New Southwest International Routes

Beginning in the New Year, Southwest continues to expand from Nashville, as the hybrid airline begins a new nonstop service to both Liberia (LIR) in Costa Rica and a link to the picturesque island of Aruba (AUA).

These services will be uncontested, with Southwest being the only airline connecting to the two cities nonstop. Southwest remains the biggest airline at Nashville by far, with more than 56% of all market share at the airport. This is ahead of both American Airlines and Delta.

Southwest operates up to 60 nonstop routes from Nashville to key destinations across the United States. It has a handful of international routes including Cancun and San Juan (SJU) year-round, while expanded seasonal destinations include Aruba (AUA), Montego Bay, Jamaica (MBJ), San José, Costa Rica (SJO), Cabo San Lucas, Mexico (SJD), and St. Thomas, US Virgin Islands (STT).
More Choice For International Flights From Austin And Columbus

The final two international routes launching this winter include the airline's latest service from Austin Bergstrom International Airport (AUS) to San Jose (SJO). The direct link to the capital of Costa Rica starts on March 13. Southwest remains the largest airline at Austin, maintaining around 41% of all commercial flights, ahead of Delta, which is aggressively expanding at the Texas airport .

From Austin, Southwest operates to 45 destinations nonstop, with existing international routes including Cancun and San Jose del Cabo. Upcoming international routes in the winter will include San Jose, while more additional routes will kick off later next year to Nassau, Punta Cana, and Liberia.

Columbus (CMH) will gain an additional nonstop international route this March, with Punta Cana International Airport (PUJ) in the Dominican Republic becoming the airline's newest route. The service will compete head-to-head with Breeze Airways. Other winter international routes from Columbus with Southwest include Cancun, San Juan, and Punta Cana.

最新航线于 11 月 1 日首飞，连接拉斯维加斯和墨西哥，预计 2027 年初将开通更多航线。本文将探讨西南航空在冬季旅行季节（2027 年 10 月 25 日至 3 月 27 日）期间新增的 5 条国际航线。
西南航空开通拉斯维加斯至巴亚尔塔港航线

body_en: Louis is a military historian and the staff writer for History of War magazine, a leading military history monthly. He also has an interest in private and commercial aviation.

Frontier Airlines has opened reservations for its new First Class seats. These seats will be in the front two rows of the aircraft. They will be in a 2-2 configuration and include additional legroom, recline and more comfortable seating, although no lie-flat seats will be available. Tickets will be sold through Frontier's First bundle.

The first class product has been unveiled alongside other cabin enhancements targeted at premium passengers. This includes extra-legroom seating and in-seat power, which fit alongside its introduction of Starlink Wi-Fi. Completion of these measures, and of the first class product, is expected by March 5, 2027.
What Is Included In The New First Class Product?

The primary highlight of the new first class product is a better seat, which features comfortable leather and cushioning, and better legroom. A glance at the initial rendering suggests it is a step-up in comfort akin to long-haul premium economy. The pitch in these rows is 37 inches (94 cm), although Frontier is yet to reveal the seat width that first class passengers can enjoy.

The table below uses Planespotters.net data to show the Frontier fleet, which are exclusively narrowbody aircraft in the Airbus A320 family, revealing the types of aircraft where you can enjoy Frontier's First Class. The airline has previously flown Airbus A318, Boeing 737s, De Havilland Canada DHC-8-400s, and Embraer ERJs

Frontier will sell its First Class product through its First package. The pricing starts at $129 one-way. It will include the first class seat, of which there appear to be eight per aircraft, two checked bags, a carry-on bag and priority boarding. You can now select the product for flights from March 5, 2027.
There Are Extra Legroom Seats Behind First Class

The First Class announcement comes alongside a broader cabin transformation on the carrier's narrowbody Airbus jets. Rows three to eight will have extra legroom of up to 34 inches (86 cm) of pitch. The UpFront Plus seating in certain rows guarantees that the middle seat is adjacent, effectively turning the row from a 3-3 to a 2-2 configuration. Extra legroom can be purchased with Frontier's premium bundle, which starts at $90 one way, and also comes with a carry-on bag and priority boarding.
Bobby Schroeter, Chief Marketing Officer at Frontier, said

"We’re transforming what customers can expect when they fly Frontier. First Class seating, more room to stretch out, in-seat power and fast, reliable Starlink Wi-Fi will bring a new level of comfort and convenience to flying with us. We’re continuing to deliver the great value our customers count on, combining more comfort and choice with Frontier’s low fares.”
The Transformation Also Includes In-Seat Power And High-Speed Wi-Fi

Two further upgrades are planned within the Frontier cabin transformation program. Firstly, the first eight rows on all the airline's jets will have USB-C power installed for the charging of personal devices. Frontier says that installation will begin in 2027 and progress throughout the year.

Passengers will get further help to be productive, entertained, or connected through Starlink Wi-Fi, which was first announced in July 2026. Frontier is joining premium and legacy airlines like United Airlines , Qatar Airways, Air France and Emirates in bringing the technology to travelers.

Installation of Starlink Wi-Fi is also slated to begin in 2027, with gradual progress across next year. The installation will be part of a broader rollout into Indigo Partners portfolio airlines, including Wizz Air, Volaris, JetSMART and Cebu Pacific. Over 1,000 aircraft will be involved in the project. Pricing details and the exact speeds that passengers can expect are yet to be revealed.

头等舱后面有额外腿部空间的座位
推出头等舱的同时，该航空公司还对窄体空客喷气式飞机进行了更广泛的机舱改造。第三排至第八排将有额外的腿部空间，间距可达 34 英寸（86 厘米）。某些排的 UpFront Plus 座椅可确保中间座位相邻，从而有效地将排从 3-3 转变为 2-2 配置。额外的腿部空间可以通过 Frontier 的高级套餐购买，单程起价 90 美元，还附带一件随身行李和优先登机。

title_en: Premium Economy On US Airlines: How The Big 3 Actually Compare
title_zh: 美国航空公司的豪华经济舱：三大航空公司的实际比较
summary: On paper, all three offer the same premium economy seating experience.
summary_zh: 从理论上讲，这三者都提供相同的高级经济舱座位体验。
body_en: Prachi is a London-based journalist with extensive experience in the aviation industry. She has worked for several leading industry publications, covering a broad range of topics. Her expertise lies in aircraft maintenance, emerging technologies, and advanced air mobility. She is currently pursuing a PhD in Journalism, focusing on data journalism and its potential to transform conventional aviation reporting.

Demand for premium air travel is growing as passengers are increasingly prioritizing comfort when booking flights. According to consumer research, around 21% of travelers now consider physical comfort a deciding factor when allocating their holiday budgets. In response to this growing demand, airlines are investing heavily in their premium products. However, business and first class tickets remain expensive for many travelers. This is where premium economy comes in.

The cabin offers passengers more comfort and additional amenities than standard economy without the considerably higher cost of business class. In recent years, its popularity has been growing. In fact, industry data shows that the share of travelers choosing premium economy has increased from 16% to 20% year over year. Many airlines have been investing in this cabin, and the three largest US carriers, American Airlines , Delta Air Lines , and United Airlines , are no exception. In this guide, we will explore how their products compare.
US Airlines Were Late To The Premium Economy Market

It is no secret to anyone that US legacy carriers were relatively slow to enter the premium economy market . For much of the 2010s, these airlines relied on extra-legroom economy products rather than introducing a separate premium economy cabin. In fact, this approach worked well in the domestic market, but several European and Asian airlines had already taken a different direction. They began offering dedicated premium economy cabins that featured wider seats, more legroom, and a distinct onboard service.

Therefore, to remain competitive, all three US airlines introduced their own premium economy products. American Airlines was the first major US carrier to offer a dedicated premium economy cabin, introducing the product on its Boeing 787-9 aircraft in 2016. United Airlines and Delta Air Lines subsequently followed, launching Premium Plus and Premium Select, respectively.

So, how do their products compare? In terms of seating, the three airlines offer fairly similar experiences, at least on paper. All three generally provide around 38 inches of seat pitch, which measures the distance between corresponding points on successive rows of seats. Seat widths are also comparable, typically ranging from approximately 18.5 to 19 inches, depending on the airline and aircraft type.
A Closer Look At American Airlines' Premium Economy

Let’s take a look at the one world member’s premium economy seats. American Airlines offers its premium economy cabin on its Boeing 777-300ER, 777-200, and 787-9 aircraft, as well as Boeing 787-8s operating international services and flights to Alaska . The airline primarily uses Collins Aerospace MiQ seats for its premium economy product, although the airline’s new premium-configured Boeing 787-9s feature the Recaro R5, which offers larger entertainment screens, adjustable footrests and leg rests, and privacy wings.

Overall, seat pitch is standardized at 38 inches (96.5 cm) across all aircraft types, while seat width ranges from 18.5 inches (47 cm) to 19 inches (48.3 cm). Screen sizes, however, vary by seat model. Aircraft equipped with Collins MiQ seats feature 11.5-inch (29.2 cm) screens, while the newer Boeing 787-9s featuring Recaro R5 seats offer larger 13.3-inch (33.8 cm) displays.

On eligible international flights, the Dallas/Fort Worth-based airline also offers chef-inspired meals and complimentary beer, wine, and spirits when full drink service is available. In addition, passengers on long-haul flights also receive an amenity kit including some skincare and basic travel essentials. Overall, the experience is the same as economy but with a thorough upgrade.
How United Airlines' Premium Economy Compares

Now let’s take a look at United Airlines’ premium economy seats, which it markets as “ United Premium Plus ”. The airline was the last of the Big Three US carriers to introduce a dedicated premium economy product, launching the cabin in 2019. Today, Premium Plus is available on most of United’s widebody aircraft, although there are some exceptions.

According to ch-aviation , United currently operates 37 Boeing 767-300ERs, 16 767-400ERs, 55 777-200ERs, 22 777-300ERs, 12 787-8s, 64 787-9s, and 21 787-10s. Of its 55 777-200ERs, 51 feature Premium Plus. The exceptions are the airline’s high-density Boeing 777 fleet, comprising 19 777-200s and four 777-200ERs, which lack a dedicated premium economy cabin.

As for the seats themselves, United uses the Collins Aerospace MiQ model, similar to American Airlines. These offer about 38 inches (97 cm) of pitch and measure between 18.5 and 19 inches (47–48 cm) wide. Passengers also receive an upgraded onboard dining service. Premium Plus meals are specially prepared and served on ceramic plates alongside metal cutlery, rather than the disposable packaging and utensils generally used in economy.

Delta Air Lines markets its premium economy cabin as “ Delta Premium Select .” It first introduced the product in 2017 aboard its Airbus A350-900 on a flight from Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW) to Tokyo Narita Airport (NRT), becoming the second major US carrier to offer a dedicated premium economy cabin. Since then, the SkyTeam member has gradually expanded Premium Select across its international network, including on some of its older aircraft, such as the Boeing 767-400ER.

In terms of seating, Delta’s product is quite similar to its rivals’, although it features the carrier’s distinctive diamond stitching pattern. Premium Select seats generally offer 38 inches (96.5 cm) of pitch and a width of approximately 18.5 to 19 inches (47–48 cm), depending on the aircraft. Passengers also benefit from adjustable leg rests and footrests, greater recline, larger entertainment screens, and memory foam cushions for additional comfort.

Beyond the seats, the Atlanta-based airline has built a reputation for its onboard service, and Premium Select offers several improvements over standard economy. Passengers receive complimentary beer, wine, and spirits as well as soft drinks and hot beverages. The dining service also varies depending on the route, although meals are generally served on reusable tableware rather than the disposable packaging commonly found in economy.
The Big Three Continue To Invest In Premium Economy
body_zh: Prachi 是一位驻伦敦记者，在航空业拥有丰富的经验。她曾在多家领先的行业出版物工作，涵盖广泛的主题。她的专长在于飞机维护、新兴技术和先进的空中机动能力。她目前正在攻读新闻学博士学位，专注于数据新闻及其改变传统航空报道的潜力。
随着乘客在预订航班时越来越重视舒适度，对优质航空旅行的需求不断增长。根据消费者研究，大约 21% 的旅行者现在认为身体舒适度是分配假期预算时的决定性因素。为了满足这种不断增长的需求，航空公司正在大力投资其优质产品。然而，对于许多旅客来说，商务舱和头等舱机票仍然昂贵。这就是豪华经济舱的用武之地。
与标准经济舱相比，该客舱为乘客提供了更多的舒适度和额外的便利设施，而商务舱的成本却高得多。近年来，它的受欢迎程度不断增加。事实上，行业数据显示，选择豪华经济舱的旅客比例同比从 16% 上升至 20%。许多航空公司一直在投资这种客舱，美国三大航空公司美国航空、达美航空和联合航空也不例外。在本指南中，我们将探讨他们的产品如何比较。
美国航空进入豪华经济舱市场较晚
美国传统航空公司进入高端经济舱市场的速度相对较慢，这对任何人来说都不是秘密。在 2010 年代的大部分时间里，这些航空公司都依赖腿部空间更大的经济舱产品，而不是引入单独的豪华经济舱。事实上，这种做法在国内市场行之有效，但欧洲和亚洲的几家航空公司已经采取了不同的方向。他们开始提供专用的高级经济舱，其特点是更宽的座位、更多的腿部空间和独特的机上服务。
因此，为了保持竞争力，美国三大航空公司都推出了自己的高端经济舱产品。美国航空是美国第一家提供专用豪华经济舱的主要航空公司，于 2016 年在其波音 787-9 飞机上推出了该产品。联合航空和达美航空随后紧随其后，分别推出了 Premium Plus 和 Premium Select。
那么，他们的产品相比如何？在座位方面，这三家航空公司提供的体验相当相似，至少在纸面上是这样。这三者通常提供约 38 英寸的座椅间距，用于测量连续排座椅上对应点之间的距离。座椅宽度也相当，通常约为 18.5 至 19 英寸，具体取决于航空公司和飞机类型。
近距离了解美国航空的豪华经济舱

我们来看看one world会员的豪华经济舱座位。美国航空在其波音 777-300ER、777-200 和 787-9 飞机以及运营国际服务和飞往阿拉斯加的航班的波音 787-8 飞机上提供高级经济舱。该航空公司的高端经济舱产品主要使用柯林斯航空航天公司的 MiQ 座椅，尽管该航空公司的新型高级配置波音 787-9 配备了 Recaro R5，该座椅提供更大的娱乐屏幕、可调节脚踏板和腿托以及隐私翼。
总体而言，所有机型的座椅间距标准化为 38 英寸（96.5 厘米），而座椅宽度范围为 18.5 英寸（47 厘米）至 19 英寸（48.3 厘米）。然而，屏幕尺寸因座椅型号而异。配备 Collins MiQ 座椅的飞机配备 11.5 英寸（29.2 厘米）屏幕，而配备 Recaro R5 座椅的新型波音 787-9 则配备更大的 13.3 英寸（33.8 厘米）显示屏。
在符合条件的国际航班上，这家总部位于达拉斯/沃斯堡的航空公司还提供厨师风味餐点，并在提供全套饮品服务时免费提供啤酒、葡萄酒和烈酒。此外，乘坐长途航班的乘客还会收到旅行套装，其中包括一些护肤品和基本旅行必需品。总体而言，体验与经济舱相同，但进行了彻底升级。
联合航空的豪华经济舱如何比较
现在让我们来看看联合航空的豪华经济舱座位，它的营销名称是“United Premium Plus”。该航空公司是美国三大航空公司中最后一家推出专用高端经济舱产品的航空公司，于 2019 年推出了该客舱。如今，美联航的大多数宽体飞机均提供 Premium Plus 舱位，但也有一些例外。

据ch-aviation称，美联航目前运营着37架波音767-300ER、16 767-400ER、55 777-200ER、22 777-300ER、12 787-8、64 787-9和21 787-10。在 55 777-200ER 中，有 51 架配备 Premium Plus。例外情况是该航空公司的高密度波音 777 机队，包括 19 777-200 和 4 架 777-200ER，缺乏专用的豪华经济舱。
至于座椅本身，美联航使用柯林斯航空 MiQ 模型，类似于美国航空。这些间距约为 38 英寸（97 厘米），宽度在 18.5 至 19 英寸（47-48 厘米）之间。乘客还可以获得升级的机上餐饮服务。 Premium Plus 餐食是专门准备的，并与金属餐具一起放在陶瓷盘子上，而不是经济舱中通常使用的一次性包装和餐具。
达美航空将其高级经济舱称为“达美高级精选”。该公司于 2017 年在从底特律大都会韦恩县机场 (DTW) 飞往东京成田机场 (NRT) 的空中客车 A350-900 航班上首次推出该产品，成为美国第二家提供专用高级经济舱的主要航空公司。此后，天合联盟成员逐步在其国际网络中扩展高级精选服务，包括一些较旧的飞机，例如波音 767-400ER。
在座椅方面，达美航空的产品与竞争对手的产品非常相似，尽管它采用了该航空公司独特的菱形缝线图案。高级精选座椅的间距通常为 38 英寸（96.5 厘米），宽度约为 18.5 至 19 英寸（47-48 厘米），具体取决于飞机。乘客还受益于可调节的腿托和脚踏板、更大的倾斜度、更大的娱乐屏幕和记忆泡沫垫，以增加舒适度。
除了座位之外，这家总部位于亚特兰大的航空公司还因其机上服务而享有盛誉，高级精选服务比标准经济舱提供了多项改进。乘客可获赠免费啤酒、葡萄酒、烈酒以及软饮料和热饮。餐饮服务也根据航线的不同而有所不同，尽管餐食通常使用可重复使用的餐具而不是经济舱常见的一次性包装。

body_en: Couple return to the Boeing 747 where they met, 27 years later at Liège Airport - Aviation24.be
Home Air Atlanta Icelandic Air Atlanta Cargo Couple return to the Boeing 747 where they met, 27 years later...

In October 2026, Paul King and his wife Asako stepped aboard the Boeing 747 where they first met 27 years earlier. The aircraft was now a freighter at Liège Airport, and the First Class cabin where they had struck up a conversation was gone.

They met in July 1999 on an All Nippon Airways (ANA) flight from Tokyo Narita to Washington Dulles. Paul was one of just two passengers in First Class; Asako was a flight attendant on the 13-hour flight. Their conversation led to marriage and two daughters. Paul kept a note of the aircraft’s registration, JA8094 , as a reminder of where it all began.

The 747 went on to a second career in cargo. After leaving passenger service, it was converted into a freighter and re-registered TF-AMP . Magma Aviation says Air Atlanta has operated the aircraft since 2012 and that it has supported Magma’s cargo network since 2017.

Magma arranged the visit at Liège, where the couple walked through the aircraft and took photographs. Asako brought along her old ANA flight attendant’s cap. With the seats removed and the interior turned into a cargo deck, she had to picture the cabin as it was on the day they met.

2026 年 10 月，保罗·金 (Paul King) 和妻子麻子 (Asako) 登上了波音 747，这是他们 27 年前第一次见面的地方。这架飞机现在是列日机场的一架货机，他们交谈的头等舱也不见了。
他们于 1999 年 7 月在全日空航空公司 (ANA) 从东京成田飞往华盛顿杜勒斯国际机场的航班上相识。保罗是头等舱仅有的两名乘客之一。麻子是这趟 13 小时航班上的空乘人员。他们的谈话导致了婚姻和两个女儿。保罗记下了飞机的注册号 JA8094，以提醒人们这一切是从哪里开始的。
747 开始了第二个货运生涯。退出客运服务后，它被改装为货机并重新注册为 TF-AMP 。 Magma Aviation 表示，亚特兰大航空自 2012 年以来一直运营这架飞机，并自 2017 年以来一直支持 Magma 的货运网络。
Magma安排了在列日的访问，夫妇俩在那里走过飞机并拍照。麻子带来了她以前的全日空空姐帽。座椅被拆除，内部变成了货舱，她必须想象出他们见面那天的机舱样子。

title_en: SAS Boosts Flights To These 2 Major Delta Hubs For Summer 2027
title_zh: SAS 在 2027 年夏季增加飞往这两个达美航空主要枢纽的航班
summary: SAS is increasing Atlanta and Seattle flights while strengthening its Delta partnership, expanding long-haul capacity and European connectivity.
summary_zh: 北欧航空正在增加亚特兰大和西雅图的航班，同时加强与达美航空的合作伙伴关系，扩大长途运力和欧洲连接。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

SAS is increasing flights to two major Delta Air Lines hubs as part of an extensive expansion of its summer 2027 schedule. The Scandinavian carrier will increase services from Copenhagen Airport (CPH) to Atlanta and Seattle, strengthening connections with its US partner while adding capacity across a total of seven intercontinental routes.

The November 10 announcement also includes larger Airbus aircraft, more than 20 European and Scandinavian route enhancements, and two new destinations. The expansion follows SAS's transition from Star Alliance to SkyTeam , which has brought it closer to Delta and Air France-KLM .
SAS Adds More Flights To Atlanta And Seattle As Delta Partnership Deepens
Credit: Suparat Chairatprasert | Shutterstock

Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) will increase from five weekly flights to a daily service from Copenhagen, representing 40% growth, while Seattle rises from four to five weekly flights. Both changes restore previously offered frequencies: SAS launched Atlanta flights in June 2024 , shortly before its formal move to SkyTeam , wasting no time connecting into the alliance's busiest global hub. SAS also operates nonstop services to three other Delta hubs: Boston, Los Angeles and New York-JFK.

SAS' partnership with Delta formally began in September 2024, just days after joining the alliance, with a revised codeshare agreement. The expanded agreement covered 150 destinations in North America, as well as around 50 destinations in Northern Europe. The cooperation increased again in April 2025, with both carriers adding more connecting opportunities and reciprocal loyalty benefits. Paul Verhagen, Chief Commercial Officer at SAS, said at the time

“We are thrilled to continue expanding our partnership with Delta, enhancing travel options between Scandinavia and North America. As a proud new member of SkyTeam Alliance, our collaboration offers great opportunities to provide seamless connectivity and benefits across our global network."

The relationship is expected to deepen further through Air France-KLM's proposed acquisition of a controlling 60.5% stake in SAS. During its November 5 earnings call , the group's CEO Benjamin Smith said the group now hopes to complete the transaction in the first quarter of 2027, subject to European Commission approval. This could eventually support SAS joining the existing Delta–Air France–KLM–Virgin Atlantic transatlantic joint venture.
SAS Expands Five More Long-Haul Routes And Deploys Larger Airbus Aircraft

Beyond Atlanta and Seattle, SAS will increase Copenhagen flights to Tokyo Haneda Airport (HND), Seoul's Incheon International Airport (ICN), and Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) from six weekly to daily. Chicago and Mumbai will also receive more seats through aircraft upgauging, although SAS has not announced additional frequencies for these two routes.

The A350 upgauges add 34 seats per departure, with capacity rising from 266 to 300 passengers. Mumbai Airport (BOM) is particularly noteworthy, having only launched in October this year , marking SAS's return to India after 17 years. Previously operated five times weekly with the A330, the route will enter its first full summer season with larger aircraft, demonstrating the airline's longer-term ambitions in the subcontinent.

These changes precede SAS's largest-ever aircraft investment , announced in June of this year. The agreement covers up to 40 widebodies, including 18 firm Airbus A330-900 orders, two additional leased A330-900s, ten purchase rights, and up to ten additional Airbus A330-300 s . The secondhand A330s will support near-term expansion , while new-generation aircraft will underpin fleet modernization. The investment has a stated list-price value exceeding $10 billion.
SAS Strengthens Its European Network To Feed Copenhagen's Global Hub

As if that wasn't enough, SAS is also strengthening its European and Scandinavian network to support Copenhagen's development as a major international connecting hub . Flights from Copenhagen to Stockholm Arlanda Airport (ARN) will increase from 15 to 18 daily departures, while Aarhus rises from four to five daily flights. Geneva, Barcelona and Venice will also gain significant additional capacity, improving connections between European destinations and SAS's expanding long-haul network.

Beyond these confirmed increases, SAS also plans more departures from Copenhagen to Nice, Palma de Mallorca, Porto, Bilbao and Catania, although frequencies are not yet confirmed. Stockholm will gain additional flights to Luleå, Kiruna, Milan and Madrid, while Geneva and Keflavik services will operate throughout the summer. Oslo will also see increased frequencies to Manchester, Brussels and Rome.

The expansion also introduces two new seasonal destinations from Copenhagen. Ljubljana Jože Pucnik Airport (LJU) launches June 25, operating twice-weekly until August 6 with a 122-seat Embraer E195 . Menorca follows on June 30, with weekly flights until August 4 using a 180-seat Airbus A320neo . Menorca becomes SAS's third Balearic destination, while Ljubljana adds another European capital to its network. Together, the new additions reinforce Copenhagen's role as the airline's principal international hub.
body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍布 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
作为 2027 年夏季航班计划大规模扩展的一部分，北欧航空 (SAS) 正在增加飞往达美航空两个主要枢纽的航班。这家斯堪的纳维亚航空公司将增加从哥本哈根机场 (CPH) 飞往亚特兰大和西雅图的航班，加强与其美国合作伙伴的联系，同时增加总共 7 条洲际航线的运力。
11 月 10 日发布的公告还包括更大型的空客飞机、20 多条欧洲和斯堪的纳维亚航线的增强以及两个新目的地。此次扩张是在北欧航空从星空联盟过渡到天合联盟之后进行的，这使其与达美航空和法航荷航的关系更加密切。
随着达美航空合作加深，北欧航空增加了飞往亚特兰大和西雅图的更多航班
图片来源：Suparat Chairatprasert | Shutterstock
亚特兰大哈茨菲尔德-杰克逊国际机场 (ATL) 将从每周 5 趟航班增加到每天 1 趟从哥本哈根起飞的航班，增幅达 40%，而西雅图则从每周 4 趟航班增加到 5 趟。这两项变化均恢复了之前提供的航班频率：SAS 于 2024 年 6 月正式迁入天合联盟前不久推出了亚特兰大航班，立即连接到该联盟最繁忙的全球枢纽。 SAS 还运营飞往其他三个达美航空枢纽的直达航班：波士顿、洛杉矶和纽约肯尼迪机场。
SAS 与达美航空的合作关系于 2024 年 9 月正式开始，就在加入联盟几天后，并修订了代码共享协议。扩大后的协议涵盖北美 150 个目的地以及北欧约 50 个目的地。 2025 年 4 月，双方合作再次加强，两家运营商增加了更多转机机会和互惠忠诚度福利。 SAS 首席商务官 Paul Verhagen 当时表示
“我们很高兴继续扩大与达美航空的合作伙伴关系，增强斯堪的纳维亚半岛和北美之间的旅行选择。作为天合联盟的骄傲新成员，我们的合作提供了绝佳的机会，可以在我们的全球网络中提供无缝连接和福利。”
通过法航-荷航拟收购 SAS 60.5% 的控股股权，双方关系预计将进一步加深。在 11 月 5 日的财报电话会议上，该集团首席执行官本杰明·史密斯表示，该集团现在希望在获得欧盟委员会批准的情况下，在 2027 年第一季度完成交易。这最终可能会支持北欧航空加入现有的达美航空、法航、荷航、维珍航空跨大西洋合资企业。
SAS 新增 5 条长途航线并部署更大的空客飞机
除亚特兰大和西雅图之外，北欧航空还将把哥本哈根飞往东京羽田机场 (HND)、首尔仁川国际机场 (ICN) 和华盛顿杜勒斯国际机场 (IAD) 的航班从每周六班增至每日一班。芝加哥和孟买也将通过飞机升级获得更多座位，尽管北欧航空尚未宣布这两条航线的额外班次。
A350 升级后每次出发增加 34 个座位，载客量从 266 名乘客增至 300 名乘客。孟买机场 (BOM) 尤其值得关注，今年 10 月才投入使用，标志着 SAS 时隔 17 年重返印度。该航线此前由 A330 每周执飞 5 趟，此次将迎来首个使用大型飞机的完整夏季航线，展现了该航空公司在南亚次大陆的长期雄心。
这些变化发生在 SAS 于今年 6 月宣布的有史以来最大的飞机投资之前。该协议涵盖多达 40 架宽体客机，包括 18 架空客 A330-900 确认订单、另外两架租赁的 A330-900、十架购买权以及最多十架额外的空客 A330-300。二手 A330 飞机将支持近期扩张，而新一代飞机将支持机队现代化。该投资的标价价值超过 100 亿美元。
SAS 加强其欧洲网络，为哥本哈根全球中心提供电力
似乎这还不够，SAS 还在加强其欧洲和斯堪的纳维亚网络，以支持哥本哈根发展成为主要的国际枢纽。从哥本哈根飞往斯德哥尔摩阿兰达机场 (ARN) 的航班将从每日 15 班增至 18 班，而奥胡斯机场则从每日 4 班增至 5 班。日内瓦、巴塞罗那和威尼斯也将获得大量额外运力，改善欧洲目的地与 SAS 不断扩大的长途网络之间的联系。
除了这些已确认的增加航班外，北欧航空还计划增加从哥本哈根飞往尼斯、马略卡岛帕尔马、波尔图、毕尔巴鄂和卡塔尼亚的航班，但班次尚未确定。斯德哥尔摩将增加飞往吕勒奥、基律纳、米兰和马德里的航班，而日内瓦和凯夫拉维克的航班将在整个夏季运营。奥斯陆飞往曼彻斯特、布鲁塞尔和罗马的班次也将增加。

此次扩建还引入了来自哥本哈根的两个新的季节性目的地。卢布尔雅那乔泽普奇尼克机场 (LJU) 于 6 月 25 日启用，每周运营两次，直至 8 月 6 日，配备 122 个座位的巴西航空工业公司 E195。梅诺卡岛紧随其后，将于 6 月 30 日使用 180 座的空客 A320neo 每周执飞航班，直至 8 月 4 日。梅诺卡岛成为 SAS 在巴利阿里群岛的第三个目的地，而卢布尔雅那则为其网络增添了另一个欧洲首都。这些新增航班共同巩固了哥本哈根作为该航空公司主要国际枢纽的地位。

title_en: France orders two IRIS spy satellites from Airbus and Thales
title_zh: 法国向空客和泰雷兹订购两颗 IRIS 间谍卫星
summary: France’s defense procurement agency, the Direction générale de l’armement (DGA), has awarded Airbus Defence and Space and Thales… The post France orders two IRIS spy satellites from Airbus and Thales appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 法国国防采购机构总装备局 (DGA) 已授予空中客车防务航天公司和泰雷兹公司……法国后勋章
body_en: France’s defense procurement agency, the Direction générale de l’armement (DGA), has awarded Airbus Defence and Space and Thales Alenia Space a contract to build IRIS, a two-satellite system that will replace the country’s existing CSO military observation satellites.
The DGA said it awarded the contract on November 5, 2026. Airbus, which leads the industrial team, put the value at more than €1.5 billion (approximately $1.69 billion) for the entire consortium.

The contract covers the design, manufacture, and testing of both satellites, along with the user, control and image-quality ground segments. Airbus said it also includes in-orbit operations and maintenance, with work continuing until the end of the 2030s.
IRIS to replace France’s three CSO satellites by 2035

IRIS, short for Instruments de renseignement et d’imagerie spatial (Space-based intelligence and imaging instruments), will replace the three CSO satellites of the Multinational Space-based Imaging System (MUSIS), launched in 2018, 2020 and 2025. The program is unrelated to IRIS², the European Union’s secure satellite connectivity constellation.
Under France’s updated 2024-2030 military programming law , the first IRIS satellite is expected to enter service around 2033, with both satellites in orbit by 2035, according to the DGA.
Thales Alenia Space said the first satellite would replace CSO-1 and CSO-2, while the second would enter service following the end of the last CSO satellite’s operational life.
Higher-resolution imagery and surveillance of objects in orbit
IRIS is intended to improve both the quality of satellite imagery and the speed at which intelligence reaches military users.

According to the DGA, the satellites will be capable of imaging any point on Earth, day or night, using visible and infrared sensors at extremely high resolution. They will also be able to image objects in orbit, supporting space surveillance and the identification and characterization of potential threats.
The system will be operated by the French Air and Space Force’s Space Command (CDE), which has concentrated its military space activities at Air Base 101 in Toulouse .
Airbus and Thales split satellite and payload development

Airbus will provide both satellite platforms, a significant share of the first satellite’s payload and the ground segment. Thales Alenia Space will develop the next-generation payload for the second satellite, supply critical components for the first and contribute to the ground infrastructure.

Thales Alenia Space, which built the optical instruments for the CSO satellites, said IRIS will incorporate a large, highly stable telescope with next-generation active optics, high-speed digital sensors, AI-based image processing and infrared capabilities for nighttime observations.
The company’s Chief Executive Officer, Hervé Derrey, said its teams would develop “the most advanced optical instrument ever built in Europe.”
The DGA identified Lynred, Pyxalis, Sodern, Safran Reosc, and Air Liquide Advanced Technologies among the subcontractors involved.

Both the DGA and Airbus said IRIS would be open to international cooperation, allowing allied countries to access the French observation system. Airbus noted that MUSIS, its predecessor, involves eight European partners.
The contract also comes as the two main industrial partners prepare for a potential consolidation of their space activities.

In October 2025, Airbus, Leonardo and Thales signed a memorandum of understanding to combine their space businesses into a single European company codenamed Project Bromo. The companies said the new entity could become operational in 2027, subject to regulatory approval and other closing conditions.

body_zh: 法国国防采购机构总装备局 (DGA) 已授予空客防务航天公司和泰雷兹阿莱尼亚宇航公司建造 IRIS 的合同，这是一个两颗卫星系统，将取代该国现有的 CSO 军事观测卫星。
DGA 表示，它于 2026 年 11 月 5 日授予了该合同。领导工业团队的空中客车公司估计整个财团的价值超过 15 亿欧元（约合 16.9 亿美元）。
该合同涵盖两颗卫星的设计、制造和测试，以及用户、控制和图像质量地面部分。空中客车公司表示，它还包括在轨运营和维护，工作将持续到 2030 年代末。
IRIS 将于 2035 年取代法国的三颗 CSO 卫星
IRIS 是 Instruments de renseignement et d’imagerieSpatial（天基情报和成像仪器）的缩写，将取代 2018 年、2020 年和 2025 年发射的多国天基成像系统 (MUSIS) 的三颗 CSO 卫星。该计划与欧盟安全卫星连接星座 IRIS² 无关。
DGA 表示，根据法国更新的 2024-2030 年军事规划法，第一颗 IRIS 卫星预计将在 2033 年左右投入使用，两颗卫星将在 2035 年进入轨道。
泰雷兹阿莱尼亚宇航公司表示，第一颗卫星将取代 CSO-1 和 CSO-2，而第二颗卫星将在最后一颗 CSO 卫星的使用寿命结束后投入使用。
对轨道物体进行更高分辨率的图像和监视
IRIS 旨在提高卫星图像的质量和情报到达军事用户的速度。
根据 DGA 的说法，这些卫星将能够使用可见光和红外传感器以极高分辨率对地球上的任何点进行成像。它们还能够对轨道上的物体进行成像，支持太空监视以及潜在威胁的识别和表征。
该系统将由法国空军和太空部队的太空司令部（CDE）运营，该司令部将其军事太空活动集中在图卢兹的 101 号空军基地。
空客和泰雷兹分拆卫星和有效载荷开发
空中客车公司将提供两个卫星平台、第一颗卫星有效载荷和地面部分的很大一部分。泰雷兹阿莱尼亚航天公司将为第二颗卫星开发下一代有效载荷，为第一颗卫星提供关键部件，并为地面基础设施做出贡献。
为 CSO 卫星制造光学仪器的泰雷兹阿莱尼亚宇航公司表示，IRIS 将配备一台大型、高度稳定的望远镜，配备下一代主动光学器件、高速数字传感器、基于人工智能的图像处理和夜间观测红外功能。
该公司首席执行官 Hervé Derrey 表示，其团队将开发“欧洲有史以来最先进的光学仪器”。
DGA 确认参与的分包商包括 Lynred、Pyxalis、Sodern、Safran Reosc 和 Air Liquide Advanced Technologies。
DGA 和空中客车公司均表示，IRIS 将开放国际合作，允许盟国使用法国观测系统。空中客车公司指出，其前身 MUSIS 涉及八个欧洲合作伙伴。
该合同签订之际，两个主要工业合作伙伴正准备整合其太空活动。
2025 年 10 月，空客、莱昂纳多和泰雷兹签署了一份谅解备忘录，将各自的航天业务合并为一家代号为“布罗莫计划”的欧洲公司。两家公司表示，新实体可能会在 2027 年投入运营，具体取决于监管部门的批准和其他成交条件。
法国邮政从空中客车公司和泰雷兹公司订购两颗 IRIS 间谍卫星的消息首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

title_en: United’s 1st Private-Jet-Like CRJ450 Set For December Debut In Chicago
title_zh: 美联航第一架类似私人飞机的 CRJ450 将于 12 月在芝加哥首次亮相
summary: The modified CRJ200 will feature many premium uprades.
summary_zh: 改装后的 CRJ200 将进行许多高级升级。
body_en: Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

United Airlines is preparing to introduce its first CRJ450 regional jets in December, with the aircraft expected to begin operating from Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD) and Denver International Airport (DEN) before the end of 2026, according to reporting from The Points Guy . The new configuration gives the 50-seat Bombardier CRJ200 a more premium cabin, including a dedicated first-class section, while retaining the smaller aircraft’s ability to serve markets that cannot support larger regional jets. The first aircraft, registered N973SW, was converted from a CRJ200 and is operated by SkyWest Airlines for United Express. Aviation Week confirmed that the first two conversions were still underway in early November.

The launch is part of United’s effort to improve service on shorter regional routes without relying exclusively on larger aircraft. Rather than introducing a new airframe, the CRJ450 repurposes an existing jet with a revised cabin, expanded luggage storage, and onboard Wi-Fi. That approach could give smaller communities access to a more comfortable United Express product, although the airline has not announced a complete list of destinations. Lafayette, Indiana, is one example of a smaller market that could be relevant to the aircraft’s role, but it should not be treated as a confirmed CRJ450 destination.
A 41-Seat Cabin Replaces The Standard CRJ200 Layout

The CRJ450 retains the CRJ200 airframe but reduces passenger capacity from 50 to 41 seats. Its cabin includes 7 United First seats, 16 Economy Plus seats, and 18 standard economy seats. The reconfiguration creates a two-class product on an aircraft that previously operated with an all-economy layout.

United is also changing how passengers store their carry-on luggage. Overhead bins have been removed from the first-class cabin and replaced with a dedicated closet, giving passengers more open space around their seats. In economy, redesigned overhead bins are large enough to accommodate standard rollaboard bags, addressing a familiar inconvenience on smaller regional jets where larger carry-ons often have to be tagged and placed in the aircraft’s cargo hold.

The aircraft will also feature Starlink Wi-Fi, available free to MileagePlus members, according to United’s March 2026 announcement . However, the CRJ450 will not include the self-service snack bar found on United’s larger CRJ550. The result is a more upscale regional cabin, not a miniature version of a mainline aircraft.
SkyWest Is Converting Existing Aircraft For United

The first CRJ450, N973SW, began life as a CRJ200 delivered in June 2004. Aircraft records from Planespotters list its conversion in March 2026, following its previous configuration as a 50-seat regional jet. United publicly unveiled the concept that same month, but completing the first aircraft has taken longer than subsequent conversions are expected to require.

SkyWest President and Chief Operating Officer Wade Steel told investors during the company’s third-quarter earnings call that the first two aircraft were still being converted. The work includes coordinating service bulletins with manufacturer support partners, with later modifications expected to take approximately two to three weeks per aircraft. Most of the work is being performed at SkyWest’s Tucson, Arizona, maintenance base.

The program is expected to expand substantially after the initial aircraft enter service. SkyWest anticipates converting approximately 50 CRJ200s into CRJ450s by 2028 and has a multi-year agreement with United to operate 40. The regional carrier also sees potential to retrofit additional aircraft used in its own prorate operations, with the broader opportunity potentially reaching 100 conversions. These figures describe different parts of SkyWest’s plans, rather than a confirmed United fleet commitment for 100 aircraft.
Smaller Communities Could Benefit From The New Aircraft

United says the CRJ450 will primarily connect smaller cities with its hubs in Chicago and Denver. The aircraft’s reduced seating capacity gives the airline another way to offer first-class service in markets where demand may not justify a larger regional jet. It also provides more flexibility under the scope restrictions governing the number and size of regional aircraft that major US airlines can operate through their partners.

Lafayette, Indiana, could be an interesting example of the type of community that might benefit. Purdue University’s home airport has historically relied on limited regional service, and a smaller aircraft could make premium seating available on routes that would be difficult to support with a larger jet. However, United has not identified Lafayette as a planned destination, and the aircraft’s eventual assignments will depend on the airline’s network and commercial decisions. The CRJ450 also follows the strategy behind United’s CRJ550 , which uses a modified CRJ700 airframe with fewer seats and a more premium cabin. The newer -450 applies a similar concept to the smaller CRJ200. For SkyWest, converting existing aircraft offers a way to extend the usefulness of its regional fleet while giving United another option for serving smaller markets.

The first aircraft’s December debut will therefore mark more than a cabin refresh. It will test whether United can make older 50-seat regional jets more commercially attractive by selling a better onboard experience, even with fewer seats available. If the initial conversions perform as intended, the CRJ450 could become a more common sight on United Express routes connecting smaller communities with Chicago and Denver over the next two years.

body_zh: Jack 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了 Simple Flying。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。

据 The Points Guy 报道，联合航空正准备于 12 月推出首架 CRJ450 支线飞机，预计该飞机将于 2026 年底前开始在芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场 (ORD) 和丹佛国际机场 (DEN) 运营。新配置为 50 座庞巴迪 CRJ200 提供了更优质的客舱，包括专用的头等舱区域，同时保留了小型飞机为无法支持大型支线飞机的市场提供服务的能力。第一架飞机注册号为 N973SW，由 CRJ200 改装而成，由天西航空 (SkyWest Airlines) 为联合快运 (United Express) 运营。 《航空周刊》证实，11 月初前两次改装仍在进行中。
此次推出是美联航努力改善短途支线航线服务而不完全依赖大型飞机的一部分。 CRJ450 并没有采用新的机身，而是对现有的喷气式飞机进行了改造，包括改进的客舱、扩大的行李存储空间和机载 Wi-Fi。尽管该航空公司尚未公布完整的目的地列表，但这种方法可以让较小的社区获得更舒适的联合快运产品。印第安纳州拉斐特是可能与该飞机的角色相关的较小市场的一个例子，但不应将其视为已确认的 CRJ450 目的地。
41 座客舱取代标准 CRJ200 布局
CRJ450保留了CRJ200的机身，但将载客量从50个座位减少到41个座位。其客舱包括 7 个美联航头等舱座椅、16 个豪华经济舱座椅和 18 个标准经济舱座椅。此次重新配置在之前采用全经济舱布局运营的飞机上创建了两级产品。
美联航还改变了乘客存放随身行李的方式。头等舱的头顶行李箱已被拆除，取而代之的是专用衣柜，为乘客的座位周围提供了更多的开放空间。在经济舱中，重新设计的头顶行李箱足够大，可以容纳标准的滑轮行李箱，解决了小型支线飞机上常见的不便问题，即较大的随身行李通常必须贴上标签并放置在飞机的货舱中。
根据美联航 2026 年 3 月的公告，该飞机还将配备 Starlink Wi-Fi，前程万里 (MileagePlus) 会员可免费使用。不过，CRJ450 不会配备美联航较大型 CRJ550 上的自助小吃店。结果是更高档的支线客舱，而不是干线飞机的微型版本。
SkyWest 正在为美联航改装现有飞机
第一架 CRJ450 N973SW 最初作为 CRJ200 于 2004 年 6 月交付。Planespotters 的飞机记录显示，它于 2026 年 3 月进行了改装，此前其配置为 50 座支线喷气式飞机。美联航在同月公开公布了这一概念，但完成第一架飞机的时间比后续改装所需的时间要长。
SkyWest 总裁兼首席运营官 Wade Steel 在公司第三季度财报电话会议上告诉投资者，前两架飞机仍在改装中。这项工作包括与制造商支持合作伙伴协调服务公告，后期修改预计每架飞机大约需要两到三周的时间。大部分工作是在 SkyWest 位于亚利桑那州图森的维护基地进行的。
预计在首批飞机投入使用后，该计划将大幅扩展。 SkyWest 预计到 2028 年将大约 50 架 CRJ200 改装为 CRJ450，并与美联航签订了运营 40 架的多年协议。这家支线航空公司还看到了改装用于自己按比例运营的更多飞机的潜力，更广泛的机会可能达到 100 架改装。这些数字描述了 SkyWest 计划的不同部分，而不是已确认的美联航机队 100 架飞机的承诺。
较小的社区可以从新飞机中受益
美联航表示，CRJ450 将主要连接较小的城市及其芝加哥和丹佛的枢纽。该飞机座位容量的减少为该航空公司提供了另一种方式，可以在需求可能不足以证明需要购买更大支线飞机的市场中提供一流的服务。它还在管理美国主要航空公司可以通过其合作伙伴运营的支线飞机数量和尺寸的范围限制下提供了更大的灵活性。

印第安纳州拉斐特可能是可能受益的社区类型的一个有趣的例子。普渡大学的主场机场历来依赖有限的区域服务，较小的飞机可以在大型飞机难以支持的航线上提供优质座位。然而，美联航尚未将拉斐特确定为计划目的地，飞机的最终任务将取决于航空公司的网络和商业决策。 CRJ450 还遵循美联航 CRJ550 的策略，采用改进的 CRJ700 机身，座位更少，客舱更高级。较新的 -450 采用了与较小的 CRJ200 类似的概念。对于 SkyWest 来说，改装现有飞机提供了一种扩展其支线机队实用性的方法，同时为美联航提供了服务较小市场的另一种选择。
因此，第一架飞机 12 月的首次亮相不仅仅意味着机舱的更新。它将测试美联航是否可以通过提供更好的机上体验（即使可用座位较少）来使老式 50 座支线飞机更具商业吸引力。如果最初的改装按预期进行，CRJ450 可能会在未来两年内成为连接较小社区与芝加哥和丹佛的联合快车航线上更常见的景象。

Qantas will launch non-stop flights between Sydney and London in October 2027 under its Project Sunrise programme, retaining the QF1 and QF2 flight numbers long associated with the Kangaroo Route. The airline says the new service will save up to four hours compared with its current service via Singapore. When the route began in 1947, the journey took four days and seven stops.

The flights will use specially configured Airbus A350-1000ULRs, each with 238 seats across four cabins and an additional 20,000-litre fuel tank. Qantas says the aircraft can fly more than 16,000 kilometres and remain airborne for up to 22 hours. The first of 12 aircraft is expected to arrive in April 2027, with tickets due to go on sale in February.
Qantas will retain its Sydney–London service via Singapore under flight numbers QF5 and QF6. Those numbers are currently used on the seasonal Perth–Rome service, which will become QF105 and QF106.

body_en: Alpi Aviation’s Pioneer 800 Twin made its first flight on November 5, 2026. The four-seat aircraft is powered by two 160 hp Rotax 916 iS engines, each driving an MT propeller.

Alpi builds light aircraft in San Quirino, near Pordenone in northeastern Italy. The company built its first aircraft, the two-seat Pioneer 300, in 1999 and later expanded the line to include the four-seat, single-engine Pioneer 400.
Alpi showed the 800 Twin with its current engines at AERO Friedrichshafen in April 2026.
Alpi quotes a cruise speed of 200 knots at 15,000 feet and 75% power. It lists a maximum range of 1,150 nautical miles and useful load of 600 kilograms (1,323 pounds).
Gull-wing doors on either side provide access to the cabin, and the cockpit features a 12-inch Dynon SkyView HDX display.
The company previously announced a price of €350,000 when introducing the Pioneer 800.

Italy’s Tecnam also builds a four-seat Rotax twin, the P2006T NG, which uses two 100 hp engines and has a published maximum cruise speed of 148 knots. Diamond Aircraft quotes 175 knots at 75% power at 16,000 feet for its diesel-powered DA42-VI, compared with Alpi’s claimed 200 knots at the same power setting at 15,000 feet.
The post Alpi Aviation’s Rotax-powered Pioneer 800 Twin makes first flight appeared first on AeroTime .
body_zh: Alpi Aviation 的 Pioneer 800 Twin 于 2026 年 11 月 5 日首飞。这架四座飞机由两台 160 马力 Rotax 916 iS 发动机提供动力，每台发动机驱动一个 MT 螺旋桨。
阿尔皮在意大利东北部波代诺内附近的圣基里诺制造轻型飞机。该公司于 1999 年制造了第一架飞机，即两座 Pioneer 300，后来扩大了产品线，包括四座、单引擎 Pioneer 400。
Alpi 于 2026 年 4 月在 AERO Friedrichshafen 展示了配备当前发动机的 800 Twin。
Alpi 给出的巡航速度为 15,000 英尺处的巡航速度为 200 节，功率为 75%。它列出的最大航程为 1,150 海里，有效负载为 600 公斤（1,323 磅）。
两侧的鸥翼门可通往机舱，驾驶舱配有 12 英寸 Dynon SkyView HDX 显示屏。
该公司此前在推出 Pioneer 800 时宣布售价为 35 万欧元。
意大利 Tecnam 还生产了一款四座 Rotax 双缸飞机 P2006T NG，它使用两台 100 马力发动机，公布的最大巡航速度为 148 节。 Diamond Aircraft 为其柴油动力 DA42-VI 报价为 175 节，在 75% 功率下，在 16,000 英尺的高度，而 Alpi 声称在相同功率设置下，在 15,000 英尺的高度，速度为 200 节。

Home Airports Copenhagen Airport (CPH) SAS adds Copenhagen long-haul capacity and two new routes for summer 2027

SAS will increase capacity on seven long-haul routes from Copenhagen in summer 2027, add flights or extend operating seasons on more than 20 routes across Scandinavia and Europe, and launch seasonal services to Ljubljana and Menorca.

Flights from Copenhagen to Tokyo, Seoul and Washington will rise from six weekly departures to daily, while Atlanta will go from five weekly to daily. Seattle will increase from four to five flights a week. The larger Airbus A350 will replace the A330 on services to Chicago and Mumbai, with Mumbai operating for its first full summer season.

SAS will also add capacity from Oslo to Brussels, Manchester and Rome. From Copenhagen, Stockholm will rise from 15 to up to 18 daily departures, while Geneva will increase from 13 to 19 weekly flights.

Ljubljana will be served twice weekly from 25 June to 6 August with a 122-seat Embraer E195. Menorca will operate weekly from 30 June to 4 August with a 180-seat Airbus A320neo. Both routes are available to book from 10 November 2026.

title_zh: 为什么联合航空在其 CES 东京航线上接受 222 座喷气式飞机而不是标准 257 座喷气式飞机
summary: This selection is all about being opportunistic and using what was available.
summary_zh: 这种选择完全是为了机会主义和利用可用的东西。
body_en: Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

In January 2027, United Airlines will begin new nonstop flights between Tokyo Narita International Airport (NRT) and Las Vegas Harry Reid International Airport (LAS). This is an unusual launch on the surface, since LAS is not a major hub for the airline, but it is a limited service scheduled around the annual Consumer Electronics Show (CES), held from January 6 to January 9. The carrier will run three NRT-LAS flights on January 3, 4, and 5, and three LAS-NRT nonstop flights on January 9, 10, and 11.

The three NRT-LAS flights before the 2027 CES will use United's Boeing 777-200ER, featuring 276 seats and 50 Polaris seats. The three flights to Tokyo, however, will use the Boeing 787-9 rather than the 777. More interestingly, the airline will use its new Elevated 787-9 with its latest interiors and a premium-heavy configuration, featuring 64 Polaris suites and just 222 seats in total. It's unusual to use two different aircraft on the same route in opposite directions, especially when one has 54 more seats than the other.

While LAS is a large spoke for United, it's not a particularly high-priority market, and the CES services exist to better serve existing Star Alliance customers who need to travel from Asia to CES nonstop, helping retain customer loyalty. In addition, these services also help expand United's and All Nippon Airways' (the two operate a metal-neutral transpacific joint venture) potential customer base, as some customers may have booked away from the two in the past for CES due to the lack of a nonstop.

These routes work because of the sudden surge in demand to Las Vegas during this period, but they won't operate for a long period of time, which means United needs to find extra aircraft capable of operating the route. The 777 is coming from San Francisco, with United scheduling a second daily flight from San Francisco to NRT under the flight number UA 936 on January 2, 3, and 4. In NRT, the 777 turns around for UA 937 to LAS; after arrival, it operates a service to San Francisco again.

The return leg with the 787-9 works slightly differently. United has not scheduled a domestic leg to LAS with the Elevated 787-9, which means that the aircraft will need to be ferried . It then operates UA 7 to NRT, turns around, then operates UA 6 to IAH. Crucially, UA 7 is ordinarily used for the airline's outbound service from IAH to NRT, but this flight simply won't operate on the three days when the LAS-NRT flights are running. In contrast, United is adding a second 777 flight from SFO to NRT to position the aircraft for the NRT-LAS flight.

With these services, United is essentially using spare aircraft capacity, with the 777-200ER fleet having enough slack during those three days to operate a SFO-NRT-LAS-SFO rotation. Meanwhile, the airline felt that it was lucrative to cancel the outbound IAH-NRT leg for three days and use the Elevated 787-9 from LAS to NRT. Importantly, these decisions are being made based on what aircraft is available, not necessarily because the carrier needs to fly the 777-200ER or Elevated 787-9 on this service.

Every business decision comes with an opportunity cost. In the case of the LAS-NRT flight, United chose to cancel the IAH-NRT flight for three days and use that aircraft to operate the LAS-NRT flight, a decision weighed against pulling an aircraft from elsewhere . This doesn't necessarily mean that the IAH-NRT flight is particularly weak, but the math favored this solution above all others. In addition, the Elevated 787-9 could also be particularly desirable for this route.

The Elevated Interior and 222-seat layout debuted only in 2026, while January 2027 will be the first time United operates CES services. Primarily, these flights are about increasing customer loyalty and expanding the customer base, so United is putting its latest and greatest aircraft on this route. The Elevated 787-9 not only has the airline's newest seats, but it also has an extremely premium-heavy layout, and exposing these customers to the best United can offer further supports its mission.

Decisions like these involve multiple factors, including the IAH-NRT flight's performance on the selected days, the value of flying the Elevated 787-9 on LAS-NRT, the opportunity cost of pulling an aircraft from another route, and availability. It's also worth noting that mid-January generally has low travel demand in the US, which may explain why United could source a spare 777 and why United may have been inclined to cancel the IAH-NRT flight for three days . Of course, the airline has not confirmed these reasons.

The Elevated 787-9 has significantly fewer seats than United's standard 787-9, but it has substantially more premium capacity. For the customer base booking flights for CES, the added Polaris and Premium Plus capacity is exactly what is desired, which means that yields will likely remain high while most of the seats will still be filled. As such, the carrier should earn a substantial amount of revenue from operating this route with the Elevated 787-9, even if economy capacity is low.

Although the Elevated 787-9 has significantly more premium seats than the Boeing 777-200ER , the 777 is still a very premium-heavy aircraft. With 50 Polaris seats and 24 Premium Plus seats, the 777-200ER has more premium capacity than the standard 787-9, and it is one of the most premium-heavy aircraft in United's fleet. The use of the 777-200ER demonstrates that the airline clearly saw strong premium demand, even if the return flight uses an even more premium-heavy aircraft.

Offering the Elevated 787-9 on this route may have been United's priority, but the aircraft may not have been available to pull from another service in both directions. This could be why the airline instead pulled a 777-200ER for the flights to LAS, but then took an Elevated 787-9 from the Houston route on days when demand may have been weaker. Because of the limited nature of this route, opportunity cost plays a much bigger factor.

body_zh: Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。

2027 年 1 月，联合航空将开通东京成田国际机场 (NRT) 和拉斯维加斯哈利里德国际机场 (LAS) 之间的新直飞航班。从表面上看，这是一次不同寻常的启动，因为 LAS 并不是该航空公司的主要枢纽，但它是在 1 月 6 日至 1 月 9 日举行的年度消费电子展 (CES) 前后安排的有限航班。该航空公司将在 1 月 3 日、4 日和 5 日运营 3 趟 NRT-LAS 航班，并在 1 月 9 日、10 日和 11 日运营 3 趟 LAS-NRT 直飞航班。

2027 年 CES 之前的三趟 NRT-LAS 航班将使用美联航的波音 777-200ER，拥有 276 个座位和 50 个 Polaris 座位。不过，飞往东京的三趟航班将使用波音 787-9，而不是 777。更有趣的是，该航空公司将使用其新型高架 787-9，采用最新的内饰和高级重型配置，拥有 64 间北极星套房，总共只有 222 个座位。在同一条航线上朝相反方向使用两架不同的飞机是不常见的，特别是当一架飞机比另一架多 54 个座位时。
虽然 LAS 是美联航的一个重要市场，但它并不是一个特别优先的市场，CES 服务的存在是为了更好地服务需要从亚洲直飞 CES 的现有星空联盟客户，从而帮助保持客户忠诚度。此外，这些服务还有助于扩大美联航和全日空航空公司（两家公司经营一家金属中性跨太平洋合资企业）的潜在客户群，因为一些客户过去可能因为缺乏直达航班而从这两家公司预订了 CES 的机票。
这些航线之所以能够运作，是因为这段时间前往拉斯维加斯的需求突然激增，但它们不会在很长一段时间内运营，这意味着美联航需要寻找额外的能够运营该航线的飞机。这架 777 将从旧金山起飞，美联航计划于 1 月 2 日、3 日和 4 日安排第二趟从旧金山飞往 NRT 的每日航班，航班号为 UA 936。在 NRT，777 会转机飞往 UA 937 飞往 LAS；抵达后，该公司再次运营飞往旧金山的航班。

787-9 的返回航段的工作方式略有不同。美联航尚未安排高架 787-9 飞往洛杉矶的国内航线，这意味着该飞机需要转运。然后，它运行 UA 7 至 NRT，掉头，然后运行 ​​UA 6 至 IAH。至关重要的是，UA 7 通常用于该航空公司从 IAH 飞往 NRT 的出境服务，但该航班在 LAS-NRT 航班运行的三天内根本不会运营。相比之下，美联航正在增加第二架从 SFO 飞往 NRT 的 777 航班，以安排飞机执行 NRT-LAS 航班。
通过这些服务，美联航基本上利用了闲置的飞机运力，777-200ER 机队在这三天内有足够的余量来执行 SFO-NRT-LAS-SFO 轮换。与此同时，该航空公司认为取消三天的 IAH-NRT 出境航程并使用从 LAS 到 NRT 的高架 787-9 是有利可图的。重要的是，这些决定是根据可用的飞机做出的，不一定是因为承运商需要在该服务中驾驶 777-200ER 或高架 787-9。
每个商业决策都伴随着机会成本。就 LAS-NRT 航班而言，美联航选择取消 IAH-NRT 航班三天，并使用该飞机来运营 LAS-NRT 航班，这一决定权衡了从其他地方撤走飞机的决定。这并不一定意味着 IAH-NRT 飞行特别弱，但从数学角度来看，这个解决方案比其他所有解决方案都更受青睐。此外，高架 787-9 也可能特别适合这条航线。
高架内饰和 222 个座位的布局直到 2026 年才首次亮相，而 2027 年 1 月将是美联航首次运营 CES 服务。这些航班主要是为了提高客户忠诚度并扩大客户群，因此美联航将其最新、最好的飞机投入这条航线。高架 787-9 不仅拥有该航空公司最新的座椅，而且还具有极其优质的布局，让这些客户能够接触到美联航可以提供的最佳服务，进一步支持其使命。
此类决策涉及多种因素，包括 IAH-NRT 航班在选定日期的表现、在 LAS-NRT 上飞行高架 787-9 的价值、从另一条航线拉出飞机的机会成本以及可用性。还值得注意的是，1 月中旬美国的旅行需求普遍较低，这或许可以解释为什么美联航可以采购一架备用 777 飞机，以及为什么美联航可能倾向于取消 IAH-NRT 航班三天。当然，这些原因航空公司均未证实。
高架 787-9 的座位数比美联航标准 787-9 少得多，但其高端运力却大得多。对于预订 CES 航班的客户群来说，增加的 Polaris 和 Premium Plus 运力正是他们所期望的，这意味着收益率可能会保持在较高水平，而大多数座位仍将被填满。因此，即使经济运力较低，该航空公司也应该通过使用高架 787-9 运营这条航线来赚取大量收入。
尽管加高型 787-9 的高级座位明显多于波音 777-200ER，但 777 仍然是一架非常高级的重型飞机。 777-200ER 拥有 50 个 Polaris 座位和 24 个 Premium Plus 座位，比标准 787-9 拥有更多的高端运力，是美联航机队中最高端的重型飞机之一。 777-200ER 的使用表明，该航空公司清楚地看到了强劲的高端需求，即使回程航班使用更高端的重型飞机。
在此航线上提供高架 787-9 可能是美联航的优先事项，但该飞机可能无法从其他航班双向起飞。这可能就是为什么该航空公司改为使用 777-200ER 飞往洛杉矶的航班，然后在需求可能较弱的日子里从休斯顿航线使用高架 787-9。由于这条路线的有限性，机会成本起着更大的作用。

美联航目前拥有 51 架国际配置的 777-200ER，而其 64 787-9 中只有 16 架采用 222 座的高架内饰布局。两个航段之间的运力存在显着不匹配，而 787 上的高端运力实际上要高得多。美联航在 777-200ER 上安装了 50 个 Polaris 座椅、24 个 Premium Plus 座椅、46 个 Economy Plus 座椅和 156 个标准经济舱座椅。与此同时，Elevated 787-9 配备 64 个 Polaris 套房、35 个 Premium Plus 座位、39 个 Economy Plus 座位以及 84 个经济舱座位。
